title: Krabi map: rocks off the beach, and every map turns
kaylee: On the Krabi map no rock island sits half on the beach or stranded on land, and she can swing the Krabi and Nan maps round with a drag, like the Thailand map.

pictures.title: The bay by Ao Nang
pictures.caption: Every rock now stands wholly in the sea; Krabi Town's twin rocks are in the river mouth, Railay's cliffs just off the beach

pictures.title: Krabi and Nan maps
pictures.caption: Before: the board only sat still. Now a drag swings it round (the pink dot is the finger); a drag that starts on Nan's car still drives it
